Her dissertation on the impact of streaming on traditional cinema sharpened her focus on the ever-evolving world of film and media.  Bernthal has been having a stellar 2026 after appearing in two of the biggest blockbusters of the year with Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey and Marvel Studios/Sony's Spider-Man: Brand New Day . However, a film that is over a decade old has found redemption and will be entering a new era after finding a new streaming home on Netflix. Pitt is also taking center stage and will be entering the Netflix space in more ways than one this year.
 The epic 2014 movie Fury is arriving on Netflix on November 1, meaning that those who haven't watched the star-studded military movie or those who want to revisit it won't have to wait much longer. Films such as The Day After Tomorrow and Air Force One are also arriving on the streaming giant in November, making the month one to remember for action fans. Fury stars actors such as Pitt, Bernthal, Shia LaBeouf, Scott Eastwood, Logan Lerman, Michael Peña, Jason Isaacs, and Alicia von Rittberg.
 In April 1945, the Allies are making their final push in the European theater. A battle-hardened Army sergeant named Don "Wardaddy" Collier (played by Pitt), leading a Sherman tank and a five-man crew, undertakes a deadly mission behind enemy lines. Hopelessly outnumbered, outgunned and saddled with an inexperienced soldier in their midst, Wardaddy and his men face overwhelming odds as they move to strike at the heart of Nazi Germany.

 Fury was a solid success across the board for director David Ayer and its stars. The movie grossed over $211 million globally and debuted at the top of the U.S. box office, dethroning the legendary thriller Gone Girl . The war epic holds an impressive 75% rating from critics and 84% from audiences on Rotten Tomatoes.
 Critics stated that, " Fury bluntly underlines the dehumanising terror of conflict as the crew lurch from one suicide mission to the next ," and " Fury will stay with you, and will long be remembered as one of the best and most authentic character-driven feature films on WWII ."
 Close Jon Bernthal looking angry in Fury © Columbia Pictures 
 The tank crew (Brad Pitt, Shia LaBeouf, Jon Bernthal, Michael Pena, Logan Lerman) sit on a tank in Fury 
 A dirtied Brad Pitt looking sullen in Fury 
 That isn't the only movie that Pitt will land on Netflix in 2026, as The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth will arrive on the streaming giant on December 23 after its limited theatrical run from November 25. The actor will be reprising his Oscar-winning role as Cliff Booth from Quentin Tarantino's Once Upon A Time In...Hollywood . The WWII movie Fury and The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth will be battling it out on the streaming charts to take the top spot for most-watched movie.
 Pitt and Bernthal's Fury will arrive on Netflix on November 1.
